Name: (CP) Haley Revised and Seasonal Outfits
Author: stanloona420
Description:
This  mod offers two options: a standalone vanilla replacer, and a seasonal version that only works if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url] or SVO.

Huuuuge thanks to my modding partner [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49479613?tab=about+me]holychurros [/url]for helping out with the sprites, and of course thanks to poltergeister for the seasonal outfits mod!
[u][size=5]
To Use With Seasonal Outfits[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Unzip the Seasonal Haley file
[*]open the extracted folder and copy the [b][u]assets[/u][i] [/i][/b]folder
[*]move over to the "Seasonal Cute Characters" mod and hit paste
[*]A message should pop up that says something like "the destination has files with the same names" and give you the option to [u][b]replace [/b][/u]or [b][u]skip[/u][/b] the files
[*]Click the option to [b][u]replace[/u][/b] the files and and you're set.
[/list]
[size=5][u]To Use With SVO[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Make a backup copy of your original SVO files, just in case 
[*]Unzip the Seasonal Haley file
[*]open the extracted folder, then open the assets folder inside
[*]copy both the [u][b]characters[/b][/u] and [u][b]portraits[/b][/u] folders, then move over to the SVO mod and hit paste 
[*]A message should pop up that says something like "the destination has files with the same names" and give you the option to [u][b]replace [/b][/u]or [b][u]skip[/u][/b] the files
[*]Click the option to [b][u]replace[/u][/b] the files and and you're set.
[/list]
